title: God of War Ragnarök
summary: Adaptive triggers never reach the pad: told it runs on a Steam Deck, the game never loads Sony's library and drops every trigger effect.

excerpts.note: The game's scePadSetTriggerEffect wrapper is found by the name it hands on, not by an address.
Sony's trigger effect modes become the DualSense's own trigger effect bytes.
Each effect the game builds goes to the pad, only when it changes, and the game gets the answer it always got.

symptom: No adaptive trigger effect on a DualSense, while the game plays its rumble and, with Steam Input on, shows PlayStation buttons.
cause: Steam answers that the game runs on a Steam Deck under Wine, so the game never loads Sony's library, and its scePadSetTriggerEffect wrapper drops every effect it builds.
fix: A jump at that wrapper sends each effect to the pad as the DualSense's own trigger effect, in an output report that carries only the trigger fields.
backend: D3DMetal, through NotProton; the fix does not depend on the backend.
